neighbours.label: a word that is about to be followed by 'number'/'No.' as an identifier (incident, line, serial, decree, atomic ...): the position predicting 'number'
fire: When you phone the bank, have your account number ready.
Each engine part is stamped with a serial number on the base.
Please include the invoice number on your payment.
The officer gave me a crime reference number for the insurer.
Write your student ID number at the top of the sheet.
The flight number is printed on your boarding pass.
Check the model number on the back of the fridge.
Quote your order number in all emails to support.
quiet: When you phone the bank, have your questions ready.
Each engine part is stamped with the maker's logo on the base.
Please include a short note with your payment.
The officer gave me a lift to the insurer's office.
Write your full name at the top of the sheet.
The gate is printed on your boarding pass.
Check the door seal on the back of the fridge.
Mention your problem in all emails to support.

notes: Card: peaks on 'incident' (number 101), 'line' (numbers), 'Atomic' (Numbers), 'Decree' (No:), 'hadith' (#), 'Approval' (N 027); the + pole's output promotes ' numbers', ' no', ' nos'. Near misses use the same nouns where no number follows.
